thread:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: SEV2 - Elevated 5xx rate from model-serving runtime (service: runtime-models). Trigger: 3min > 5xx rate 12% (baseline 0.4%). Paged: oncall-anna.

oncall-anna: I'm on it. grabbing current dashboard.
sre-liam: I see a spike in 502/504 from model-runner on gke-cluster-a, roughly 03:10-03:18 UTC. Latency also up.
runtime-dev-maya: Logs showing repeated worker exits with signal 11 on node gpu-45. segfault traces in /var/log/runtime/runner.log.
eng-platform-cole: Noted, autoscaler didn't trigger because pods were restart-looping. Might be crashloop backoff.
product-ops-jane: Any customer-facing impact? Support is seeing error surfaces in EU region.
support-raj: Multiple customers reported 5xx errors in production (chat and api) since ~03:12. Some requests got 502, some timed out. Ticket count rising.

sre-liam: Reproducing locally against same model leads to crash after ~200 tokens. Suspect memory corruption on specific quant kernel path.
runtime-dev-maya: Agree. Heap growth looks normal until dense attention step then segfault. Pasting snippet from runner.log: ```
2026-03-15T03:14:02Z runtime-runner[pid:2145]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f2a... sp 0x7ffd... error 4 in libquant.so
2026-03-15T03:14:03Z runtime-runner[pid:2145]: backtrace: ... model_kernel_attention+0x4b
```
eng-platform-cole: Can we hot rollback to older runtime build that doesn't use libquant optimizations?
runtime-dev-maya: We have a 2026-03-10 build without the new attention kernel. It passed integration. We can rollout as immediate mitigation.
oncall-anna: Do it. Prioritize minimizing customer impact. Coordinate here before pushing.

eng-platform-cole: Starting canary rollback: kubectl set image deployment/model-runner model-runner=registry.redwood:model-runner:20260310-canary -n prod-eu
sre-liam: Monitoring. If canary is stable for 2 minutes, push to remaining replicas.
product-ops-jane: Notifying support and account owners: "We observed elevated 5xx errors; applying mitigation, may cause brief request replay."
support-raj: I'll post a status update to affected customers and update internal ticket cluster.

runtime-dev-maya: While rollback goes, capturing heap and core dumps from a crashed pod. Command: ```kubectl cp prod-eu/model-runner-123:/var/crash/core-2145.tgz /tmp/ && sudo gdb -c core ./model-runner```
sre-liam: Also enabling additional tracing: set ENV RUNTIME_TRACE=attention_kv to collect kernel traces (rolling restart required).
eng-platform-cole: Canary succeeded after 90s, error rate down from 12% -> 0.7% on canary nodes. Rolling update to remaining replicas now.
oncall-anna: Good. Continue to monitor. Keep me updated on number of failed requests and customer tickets.

product-ops-jane: Support sees error rate on tickets leveling off. I'll hold an update for affected customers in 15m with ETA.
support-raj: Confirmed: 67 unique customer requests failed; top 3 accounts impacted by >10 requests each.
runtime-dev-maya: Dump analysis: stack shows a write past end of buffer in attention kernel when sequence length > 2048 and kv cache enabled. Suspect edge-case with dynamic kv sizing.
sre-liam: For a long-term fix we'll patch kernel bounds checks and add unit tests for longer sequences. Short-term: we can apply a routing rule to limit max_seq_len to 2048 for routes hitting this model.
oncall-anna: Apply the routing control immediately as a precaution for traffic still on older canary windows.
eng-platform-cole: Applied route rule: ```route.match: model=="redwood-base-xl" -> transform.max_seq_len=2048``` across prod-eu via console-api.
runtime-dev-maya: Also adding hotfix branch to runtime repo with guard and extra asserts. PR #438 created.

product-ops-jane: Preparing customer postmortem bullet points. Please add any user-visible details.
support-raj: Adding impacted accounts list and timeline to the ticket.
oncall-anna: Pager clear criteria: error rate <= 1% sustained for 30m and core dumps collected. Current metrics: 5xx 0.6% after rollback, trending down.
sre-liam: I'll keep watch for regressions and set alert to tighter thresholds: 5xx > 1% -> page.

runtime-dev-maya: Next steps: merge hotfix, run extended CI with long-sequence tests, create canary for the patched kernel.
eng-platform-cole: We should also change autoscaler to consider restart-looping pods differently so capacity can scale out instead of waiting. Filed infra ticket INFRA-982.
product-ops-jane: Drafting customer message. ETA 20m.
support-raj: I'll follow up with affected customers and close tickets once we confirm successful replays.
oncall-anna: Thanks team. If error rate creeps up again, we'll re-escalate. For now moving to monitoring-only. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by oncall-anna. Severity remains SEV2 until mitigations stable.

sre-liam: final note: count of failed requests by endpoint: /v1/generate: 42, /v1/chat: 18, /v1/embeddings: 7. Most failures in EU cluster.
runtime-dev-maya: saved core and heap files at s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3971234567/ for postmortem.
product-ops-jane: Postmortem draft started in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/company/incidents/3971234567.
oncall-anna: Closing the live channel in 30m unless anything new. Great work everyone.
